Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS (3132-1965 

Indian Standard 

RECOMMENDATIONS FOR SHAFT 
DIAMETERS FOR CHEMICAL EQUIPMENT 

0. FOREWORD 

0,1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institu- 
tion on 25 May 1965, after the draft finalized by the Chemical Engineering 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering 
Division Council. 

0.2 Many chemical equipment are provided with a rotating member for 
stirring, mixing, conveying, etc. To help the designer alid manufacturer 
of such equipments, it is desirable that a recommended series of preferred 
shaft diameters are laid down, 

0.3 The recommended diameters given in this recommendation are classi- 
fied into two series, namely, preferred and choice 2. It is recommended 
that the shaft diameters are chosen, as far as possible, from the preferred 
series. Where a series finer than the one recommended in the preferred 
series is absolutely necessary or the shaft diameter needs to be stepped, the 
diameters given in the series under choice 2 may be chosen. 

0.4 In preparing this standard, considerable assistance has been derived 
from DIN 28132: 1953 ^ Shaft diameters of stirrers of chemical plant' 
issued by the Deutscher Normenausschuss* 



1. SCOPE 

1,1 This standard specifies the preferred diameters of shafts of stirrers, 
agitators and mixers used in chemical plant, 

2. TERMINOLOGY 

2.0 For the purpose of this standard, the following definition shall apply. 

2.1 Shaft Diameter — The diameter of the shaft in millimetres at the 
point of entry into the vessel, 

3. SHAFT DIAMETERS 

3.1 The shaft diameters shall be as given in Table L 

3 



IS 1 3132- 1965
